<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="light">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Prajakta Pol | Electronics & Industrial Automation Engineer</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Portfolio of Prajakta Pol - Electronics and Telecommunication Engineer specializing in Industrial Automation, PLC Programming, and Control Systems." />
  
  <!-- Google Fonts: Playfair Display for elegant headings, Plus Jakarta Sans for clean body -->
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,600&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />

  <!-- Favicon -->
  <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="./favicon.svg" />

  <style>
    /* ==========================================================================
       CSS VARIABLES & THEME SYSTEM (Light & Dark)
       Palette: Warm Ivory, Blush Pink, Lavender, Soft Sage Green, Deep Plum Text
       ========================================================================== */
    :root {
      /* Base & Surfaces */
      --bg-canvas: #FAF7F2;              /* Warm ivory base */
      --bg-canvas-rgb: 250, 247, 242;
      --bg-surface: #FFFFFF;             /* Crisp card surface */
      --bg-surface-glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      --bg-subtle: #F4EFEA;              /* Secondary surface */
      --bg-pill: #F6F1EA;

      /* Brand Palette */
      --color-plum: #2D1B2A;             /* Deep plum primary text */
      --color-plum-light: #4A3346;       /* Plum secondary text */
      --color-plum-muted: #7E6779;       /* Muted plum text */
      --color-plum-rgb: 45, 27, 42;

      --blush-light: #FCECEE;
      --blush-base: #F5CBD0;
      --blush-accent: #E28C96;
      --blush-glow: rgba(226, 140, 150, 0.28);

      --lavender-light: #F2EEF8;
      --lavender-base: #DACFF0;
      --lavender-accent: #8E78B8;
      --lavender-glow: rgba(142, 120, 184, 0.25);

      --sage-light: #EFF5F1;
      --sage-base: #C8DDD0;
      --sage-accent: #527A65;
      --sage-glow: rgba(82, 122, 101, 0.22);

      --gold-sparkle: #ECC369;

      /* UI Accents */
      --border-subtle: rgba(74, 51, 70, 0.1);
      --border-medium: rgba(74, 51, 70, 0.18);
      --border-accent: rgba(226, 140, 150, 0.35);

      --shadow-sm: 0 4px 12px rgba(45, 27, 42, 0.04);
      --shadow-card: 0 12px 32px -6px rgba(45, 27, 42, 0.06), 0 2px 6px rgba(45, 27, 42, 0.03);
      --shadow-hover: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(45, 27, 42, 0.12), 0 0 0 1px var(--blush-accent);

      /* Typography */
      --font-serif: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
      --font-sans: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
      --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;

      --transition-smooth: all 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] {
      /* Dark Mode Palette: Velvet Midnight Plum, Luminous Blush, Lavender Glow */
      --bg-canvas: #160E18;
      --bg-canvas-rgb: 22, 14, 24;
      --bg-surface: #221526;
      --bg-surface-glass: rgba(34, 21, 38, 0.86);
      --bg-subtle: #2B1C30;
      --bg-pill: #34223A;

      --color-plum: #FBF7F2;             /* Luminous ivory in dark */
      --color-plum-light: #D9C8D6;       /* Warm silvery mauve */
      --color-plum-muted: #9E889A;
      --color-plum-rgb: 251, 247, 242;

      --blush-light: #381E27;
      --blush-base: #F597A4;
      --blush-accent: #FFAEBA;
      --blush-glow: rgba(255, 174, 186, 0.28);

      --lavender-light: #2A1D3A;
      --lavender-base: #BFAEE3;
      --lavender-accent: #D2C4F5;
      --lavender-glow: rgba(210, 196, 245, 0.22);

      --sage-light: #1A2B23;
      --sage-base: #8EBF9F;
      --sage-accent: #AEE2C3;
      --sage-glow: rgba(174, 226, 195, 0.2);

      --gold-sparkle: #F6D888;

      --border-subtle: rgba(251, 247, 242, 0.1);
      --border-medium: rgba(251, 247, 242, 0.18);
      --border-accent: rgba(245, 151, 164, 0.4);

      --shadow-sm: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
      --shadow-card: 0 16px 36px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
      --shadow-hover: 0 22px 48px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 0 1px var(--blush-accent);
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       GLOBAL RESET & BASE STYLES
       ========================================================================== */
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      font-size: 16px;
    }

    body {
      background-color: var(--bg-canvas);
      color: var(--color-plum);
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      line-height: 1.65;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      transition: background-color 0.4s ease, color 0.4s ease;
      position: relative;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    /* Ambient Background Texture: Soft Circuit Watermark & Gentle Mesh Glows */
    .ambient-bg {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .ambient-orb {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(90px);
      opacity: 0.55;
      animation: floatOrb 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .ambient-orb-1 {
      top: -100px;
      left: -80px;
      width: 480px;
      height: 480px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--blush-base), transparent 70%);
    }

    .ambient-orb-2 {
      top: 35%;
      right: -120px;
      width: 520px;
      height: 520px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--lavender-base), transparent 70%);
      animation-delay: -6s;
    }

    .ambient-orb-3 {
      bottom: 5%;
      left: 10%;
      width: 440px;
      height: 440px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--sage-base), transparent 70%);
      animation-delay: -11s;
    }

    @keyframes floatOrb {
      0% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); }
      50% { transform: translate(30px, 40px) scale(1.08); }
      100% { transform: translate(-25px, 20px) scale(0.96); }
    }

    /* Subtle circuit traces in background */
    .circuit-grid-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background-image: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, var(--border-subtle) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 44px 44px;
      opacity: 0.45;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    /* Container */
    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1180px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 1.5rem;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       TYPOGRAPHY
       ========================================================================== */
    h1, h2, h3, h4, .font-serif {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--color-plum);
      letter-spacing: -0.015em;
      line-height: 1.25;
    }

    p {
      color: var(--color-plum-light);
      font-size: 1.025rem;
    }

    /* Badge & Micro Pills */
    .aesthetic-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: 0.38rem 0.95rem;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      background: var(--bg-surface-glass);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
      color: var(--color-plum);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
    }

    .badge-sparkle {
      color: var(--gold-sparkle);
      display: inline-block;
      animation: sparkleRotate 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes sparkleRotate {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
      50% { transform: rotate(20deg) scale(1.2); }
    }

    /* Section Headers */
    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 680px;
      margin: 0 auto 3.5rem auto;
    }

    .section-tag {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--blush-accent);
      font-weight: 600;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 2.75rem);
      margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
      position: relative;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .section-subtitle {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      color: var(--color-plum-muted);
    }

    /* Circuit Trace Divider */
    .circuit-divider {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      margin: 1.25rem auto 0 auto;
      max-width: 220px;
    }

    .circuit-divider .line {
      flex: 1;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--border-accent), transparent);
    }

    .circuit-divider .node {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--blush-accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--blush-accent);
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       BUTTONS
       ========================================================================== */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      padding: 0.82rem 1.65rem;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      font-size: 0.95rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      outline: none;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blush-accent), #CE7580);
      color: #FFFFFF;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px var(--blush-glow);
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] .btn-primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E67A88, #C45F6D);
      color: #FFFFFF;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -4px rgba(230, 122, 136, 0.4);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 26px -4px var(--blush-glow);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background: var(--bg-surface-glass);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      color: var(--color-plum);
      border-color: var(--border-medium);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-color: var(--blush-accent);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       HEADER & NAVIGATION BAR
       ========================================================================== */
    .header-nav {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      width: 100%;
      z-index: 100;
      padding: 1rem 0;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      background: rgba(var(--bg-canvas-rgb), 0.82);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      transition: padding 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
    }

    .nav-container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
    }

    /* Logo: Cute Spark & Circuit Flower */
    .nav-logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: var(--color-plum);
    }

    .circuit-flower-icon {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: var(--blush-light);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
      border-radius: 12px;
      transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }

    .nav-logo:hover .circuit-flower-icon {
      transform: rotate(18deg) scale(1.08);
    }

    .logo-text-group {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .logo-name {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }

    .logo-role {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--color-plum-muted);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* Desktop Nav Links */
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1.75rem;
      list-style: none;
    }

    .nav-link {
      color: var(--color-plum-light);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 0.92rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: color 0.2s ease;
      position: relative;
      padding: 0.3rem 0;
    }

    .nav-link::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 0%;
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blush-accent), var(--lavender-accent));
      border-radius: 2px;
      transition: width 0.25s ease;
    }

    .nav-link:hover {
      color: var(--color-plum);
    }

    .nav-link:hover::after,
    .nav-link.active::after {
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* Right Controls: Theme Toggle & Mobile Toggle */
    .nav-controls {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
    }

    /* Theme Toggle Pill */
    .theme-toggle-btn {
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
      color: var(--color-plum);
      padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem;
      border-radius: 9999px;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.45rem;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      transition: var(--transition-smooth);
    }

    .theme-toggle-btn:hover {
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border-color: var(--blush-accent);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    .theme-icon-slot {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    /* Mobile Hamburger */
    .mobile-menu-btn {
      display: none;
      background: var(--bg-subtle);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--color-plum);
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* Mobile Navigation Drawer */
    .mobile-drawer {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      top: 68px;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--bg-surface-glass);
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
      padding: 1.5rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      z-index: 99;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 1rem;
      transform: translateY(-10px);
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, opacity 0.3s ease;
    }

    .mobile-drawer.open {
      display: flex;
      transform: translateY(0);
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }

    .mobile-nav-link {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--color-plum);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      padding: 0.5rem 0;
      border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border-subtle);
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }

    /* ==========================================================================
       HERO SECTION
       ========================================================================== */
    .hero-section {
      padding: 4.5rem 0 5rem 0;
      position: relative;
    }

    .hero-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 3.5rem;
    }

    .hero-content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    .hero-heading {
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 4.8vw, 3.6rem);
      line-height: 1.15;
      margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .hero-heading span.name-accent {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blush-accent) 0%, var(--lavender-accent) 100%);
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 2.2vw, 1.6rem);
      color: var(--lavender-accent);
      margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 400;
    }

    [data-theme="dark"] .hero-subtitle {
      color: var(--lavender-base);
    }

    .hero-bio {
      font-size: 1.08rem;
      color: var(--color-plum-light);
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      max-width: 540px;
    }

    .hero-actions {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 1rem;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
    }

    /* Ladder Logic Micro Banner in Hero */
    .hero-ladder-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.6rem;
      padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem;
      background: var(--bg-surface-glass);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      border-radius: 12px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--color-plum-muted);
    }

    .ladder-symbol {
      color: var(--sage-accent);
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* HERO VISUAL AREA (Photo + Mini PLC Illustration + Floating Cards) */
    .hero-visual {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .photo-composition-wrap {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 380px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* Photo Frame with Soft Architectural Curves & Blush Halo */
    .photo-frame-outer {
      position: relative;
      width: 290px;
      height: 360px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      border-radius: 140px 140px 36px 36px;
      padding: 8px;
      background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--blush-base), var(--lavender-base), var(--sage-base));
      box-shadow: 
        0 24px 50px -12px var(--blush-glow),
        0 0 0 1px var(--border-accent);
      transition: transform 0.4s ease;
    }

    .photo-frame-outer:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
    }

    .photo-inner-canvas {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: 132px 132px 30px 30px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--bg-canvas);
      position: relative;
    }

    .profile-photo {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center 18%;
      display: block;
      transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
    }

    .photo-frame-outer:hover .profile-photo {
      transform: scale(1.04);
    }

    /* Decorative Circuit Flower Corner Charm */
    .circuit-flower-charm {
      position: absolute;
      top: -12px;
      right: 12px;
      width: 52px;
      height: 52px;
      background: var(--bg-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      z-index: 4;
      animation: gentleFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    @keyframes gentleFloat {
      0% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg); }
      100% { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(8deg); }
    }

    /* Floating Card 1: "Curious mind. Creative engineer." */
    .floating-card-mind {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: -15px;
      left: -20px;
      background: var(--bg-surface-glass);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
      border-radius: 18px;
      padding: 0.85rem 1.15rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.75rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      z-index: 5;
      animation: floatBadge 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    @keyframes floatBadge {
      0% { transform: translateY(0); }
      100% { transform: translateY(-10px); }
    }

    .floating-card-mind .avatar-spark {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--lavender-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--lavender-accent);
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }

    .floating-card-mind .mind-title {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--color-plum);
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .floating-card-mind .mind-sub {
      font-size: 0.74rem;
      color: var(--color-plum-muted);
    }

    /* Interactive Mini PLC Controller Illustration Card (Side Badge) */
    .mini-plc-card {
      position: absolute;
      top: 60px;
      left: -35px;
      background: var(--bg-surface-glass);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
      border: 1px solid var(--border-medium);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 0.75rem 0.95rem;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      z-index: 4;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      animation: floatBadge 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate-reverse;
      width: 175px;
    }

    .plc-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
      padding-bottom: 0.35rem;
    }

    .plc-title {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.68rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--color-plum);
    }

    .plc-leds {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .plc-led {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .led-pwr { background: #4ADE80; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #4ADE80; }
    .led-run { background: #38BDF8; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #38BDF8; animation: ledPulse 1.8s infinite; }

  <script>
    (function () {
      'use strict';

      // --- 1. Theme Toggle System (Light / Dark) with LocalStorage ---
      const htmlEl = document.documentElement;
      const themeToggleBtn = document.getElementById('themeToggleBtn');
      const themeIconSlot = document.getElementById('themeIconSlot');
      const themeToggleLabel = document.getElementById('themeToggleLabel');

      const sunSvg = `
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"></circle>

          <line x1="1" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12"></line>
          <line x1="21" y1="12" x2="23" y2="12"></line>
          <line x1="4.22" y1="19.78" x2="5.64" y2="18.36"></line>
          <line x1="18.36" y1="5.64" x2="19.78" y2="4.22"></line>
        </svg>`;

      const moonSvg = `
        <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
          <path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path>
        </svg>`;

      function setTheme(theme) {
        htmlEl.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
        localStorage.setItem('prajakta_portfolio_theme', theme);

        if (theme === 'dark') {
          themeIconSlot.innerHTML = moonSvg;
          themeToggleLabel.textContent = 'Dark';
        } else {
          themeIconSlot.innerHTML = sunSvg;
          themeToggleLabel.textContent = 'Light';
        }
      }

      // Check saved theme or system preference
      const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('prajakta_portfolio_theme');
      if (savedTheme) {
        setTheme(savedTheme);
      } else {
        const prefersDark = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
        setTheme(prefersDark ? 'dark' : 'light');
      }

      themeToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        const currentTheme = htmlEl.getAttribute('data-theme') || 'light';
        const newTheme = currentTheme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
        setTheme(newTheme);
      });

      // --- 2. Mobile Drawer Navigation ---
      const mobileMenuBtn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
      const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobileDrawer');
      const mobileLinks = mobileDrawer.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-link');

      mobileMenuBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
        mobileDrawer.classList.toggle('open');
      });

      mobileLinks.forEach(link => {
        link.addEventListener('click', function () {
          mobileDrawer.classList.remove('open');
        });
      });

      // --- 3. Interactive Mini PLC Demo in Hero ---
      const plcLadderToggleBtn = document.getElementById('plcLadderToggleBtn');
      const rungContact = document.getElementById('rungContact');
      const rungCoil = document.getElementById('rungCoil');
      const plcRunLed = document.getElementById('plcRunLed');
      let isEnergized = false;

      if (plcLadderToggleBtn && rungContact && rungCoil) {
        plcLadderToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          isEnergized = !isEnergized;
          if (isEnergized) {
            rungContact.textContent = '--[ I0.1 ]*--';
            rungContact.style.color = 'var(--blush-accent)';
            rungContact.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
            rungCoil.textContent = '(* Q0.1 *)';
            rungCoil.style.color = '#4ADE80';
            rungCoil.style.textShadow = '0 0 8px #4ADE80';
            plcLadderToggleBtn.innerHTML = '<span>⚡ Energized! (Click to Reset)</span>';
          } else {
            rungContact.textContent = '--[ I0.1 ]--';
            rungContact.style.color = 'var(--sage-accent)';
            rungContact.style.fontWeight = 'normal';
            rungCoil.textContent = '( Q0.1 )';
            rungCoil.style.color = 'inherit';
            rungCoil.style.textShadow = 'none';
            plcLadderToggleBtn.innerHTML = '<span>⚡ Click to Toggle Input</span>';
          }
        });
      }

      // --- 4. Copy Email & Toast Notification ---
      const copyEmailBtn = document.getElementById('copyEmailBtn');
      const copyBtnText = document.getElementById('copyBtnText');
      const copyToast = document.getElementById('copyToast');
      const emailAddress = 'polprajakta07@gmail.com';

      if (copyEmailBtn) {
        copyEmailBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          navigator.clipboard.writeText(emailAddress).then(function () {
            copyBtnText.textContent = 'Copied!';
            copyToast.classList.add('show');
            setTimeout(function () {
              copyBtnText.textContent = 'Copy Email';
              copyToast.classList.remove('show');
            }, 3000);
          }).catch(function () {
            // Fallback for older browsers
            window.location.href = 'mailto:' + emailAddress;
          });
        });
      }

      // --- 5. Resume Download Button Handler ---
      const resumeDownloadBtn = document.getElementById('resumeDownloadBtn');
      const resumeModal = document.getElementById('resumeModal');
      const closeModalBtn = document.getElementById('closeModalBtn');
      const modalDismissBtn = document.getElementById('modalDismissBtn');

      if (resumeDownloadBtn) {
        resumeDownloadBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
          // Attempt to probe or fetch resume.pdf
          fetch('./resume.pdf', { method: 'HEAD' })
            .then(function (response) {
              if (response.ok) {
                // If resume.pdf is found, download it directly
                const link = document.createElement('a');
                link.href = './resume.pdf';
                link.download = 'Prajakta_Pol_Resume.pdf';
                link.click();
              } else {
                resumeModal.classList.add('active');
              }
            })
            .catch(function () {
              resumeModal.classList.add('active');
            });
        });
      }

      function closeModal() {
        if (resumeModal) resumeModal.classList.remove('active');
      }

      if (closeModalBtn) closeModalBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      if (modalDismissBtn) modalDismissBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
      if (resumeModal) {
        resumeModal.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
          if (e.target === resumeModal) closeModal();
        });
      }

      // Update current year dynamically
      const yearEl = document.getElementById('currentYear');
      if (yearEl) {
        yearEl.textContent = new Date().getFullYear();
      }

      // Active Navigation Link Highlighting on Scroll
      const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');
      const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links .nav-link');

      window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
        let scrollY = window.pageYOffset;
        sections.forEach(current => {
          const sectionHeight = current.offsetHeight;
          const sectionTop = current.offsetTop - 120;
          const sectionId = current.getAttribute('id');

          if (scrollY > sectionTop && scrollY <= sectionTop + sectionHeight) {
            navLinks.forEach(link => {
              if (link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + sectionId) {
                link.classList.add('active');
              } else {
                link.classList.remove('active');
              }
            });
          }
        });
      });

    })();
  </script>
